- Affected part: leaf
- Large dark brown/almost black lesions at margins
- Yellow-green halo/border around necrotic areas
- Wedge/V-shaped appearance at leaf margins

Top candidates: **Verticillium_Wilt** (V-shaped lesions at margins with brown necrotic tissue surrounded by yellowing) or **Late_Blight** (dark brown patches with pale green borders).

Let me view a Verticillium Wilt reference image.

The reference image for Verticillium Wilt shows an excellent match to the test image:
- Dark brown/black necrotic lesions at leaf margins
- Prominent yellow-orange transitional zone surrounding the necrosis
- V-shaped lesion pattern
- Remainder of leaf still relatively green

This matches the symptom description: "V-shaped leaf lesions widest at the leaf margin, brown necrotic tissue surrounded by irregular yellowing."
